metadata.Description:
Maintain a secure, logically separated cloud baseline configuration, including system components, network topology, and architecture placement, with previous versions retained for rollback and tracking, using versioning tools, e.g. Git.
Establish, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system. This serves as a basis for future builds, releases, or changes to the system. The baseline configuration includes information about system components, network topology, and the logical placement of components within the system architecture.
